scope:
Run compiled NT5 translator callbacks with modeled kernel/PCI/PIC services.
No claim about physical interrupt delivery, resource arbitration, or PCI routing.

results.test: Actual Windows root PCI request installs the version-zero 24-byte translator and stdcall ABI
Unsupported translator requests fail without publishing partial callbacks
Child-to-parent supplies PIC vector/IRQL/affinity and uses the actual PIC trigger mode
Invalid and HAL-reserved lines fail without changing the target
PCI reverse translation reads the device firmware line and matches the parent vector
Legacy reverse alternatives are bounded to 16 PIC lines even with ULONG_MAX upper bound
PCI requirements use firmware IRQ instead of unrestricted descriptor range and retain attributes
USB/audio edge lines and ELCR level lines agree across forward, reverse and requirement translation; unrelated flag bits survive
Legacy requirements emit bounded valid alternatives, excluding reserved PIC lines
Allocation, PCI property and unrouted interrupt failures leave empty requirement outputs
